thread:
Jun: Noticed oddity in latency panel for /v1/embeddings -> p99 below p95 for the endpoint breakdown after we applied the quota-by-client change. p50/p95/p99 lines cross. Anyone else seeing inversion?
Marta: Yikes. That sounds like either an aggregation issue or the smoothing window is misaligned. Which panel/merge mode?
Jun: Rollout panel that splits by endpoint+client. Merge mode shows 'rollup' in metadata but the panel label just says "computed pctl".
Ravi: Common causes: 1) different ingest windows (time-aligned tdigest merge mismatch), 2) post-merge smoothing/interpolation that mixes older lower p99 samples with newer higher p95, 3) using per-shard percentiles then averaging.
Sasha: Can you dump the raw sample counts by shard? If one shard has very few samples, its p99 is noisy and will invert when merged incorrectly.
Jun: Raw counts: shard-a 40, shard-b 1200, shard-c 15. p99 on shards: a=420ms, b=78ms, c=512ms. Merged panel showed p95=210ms p99=190ms.
Telemetry-Bot: policy: quota change applied client=acme-co limit=200r/min at 2025-11-12T09:12:03Z :information_source:
Marta: That exactly matches: small shards + per-aggregate percentile merge will yield wrong ordering. If we accidentally average percentiles instead of rebuilding the distribution, p99 < p95 is possible.
Ravi: Two fixes: change merge-mode to reconstruct-sample (rebuild from tdigest centroids) or surface origin-split series so users can see per-shard percentiles. Reconstruct is more correct but memory-costly.
Jun: For the short term, is there a way to annotate panels with a warning when sample counts are low or when merge-mode != exact? Users assume curves are exact.
Sasha: I can add a low-effort badge: if total_sample_count < 1000 show "approximate percentiles" and toggle to reveal per-shard lines. UX will be a single checkbox.
Marta: Also change the API to return merge_mode and tdigest_version in the telemetry metadata endpoint: /api/console/panel/meta?panel_id=... That way the UI can show it without guessing.
Ravi: API change sounds fine. We should include compression k parameter and max_centroids. I'll file a small RFC for the extra fields.
Jun: I'll attach a short repro: console screenshot, raw query, and the shard counts. Can we include the exact SQL we used for raw check? 
Jun: ```
SELECT shard, count(*) as cnt, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) as p95, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99
FROM traces
WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND time > now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
GROUP BY shard;
```
Sasha: Ticket created: #ENGPLAT-1198 "Panel: show per-shard percentiles + warn on approximate merges" assigned to eng-platform/telemetry.
Ravi: I'll audit tdigest params across ingesters tonight (k, delta). If any node differs we'll see merge artifacts.
Marta: Follow-ups: 1) short-term UI badge + toggle (Sasha), 2) API meta fields (Marta dev), 3) longer-term: add reconstruct-sample option for critical panels or a server-side sample-resynthesis job (Ravi).
Jun: Thanks everyone. Leaving notes in the ticket with timeline and the quota event. Will ping if I see inversion elsewhere. :thumbsup:
